name: Evasive Hunter
text: Shooting attacks that target the general get -1 to hit and -1 to wound.

name: Sustained by Gore
text: At the end of any turn, heal D3 damage on the general.

name: Killing Pounce
text: Once per battle, in your charge phase, the general rolls one extra charge die for the turn, but its charge then has to end in combat with your quarry.

name: Furious Bites
text: At the end of any turn, if the general is in combat with your quarry, the quarry suffers D3 mortal damage.
